# Before / After

Component ID: before-after-contrast

## Narrative intent

并置同一对象的前后状态，让观众看清变化发生在哪里，而非误以为是两个对象。

Select this recipe only when the current story event needs that audience outcome; the animation alone is not evidence that the outcome was delivered.

## Purpose and selection

- Compare two states of the same subject on the same criterion.

Do not use:

- Do not show unrelated subjects as before/after or claim an unmeasured improvement.

## Reading order and motion

- Identify the common subject
- Read the former state
- Reveal the changed state
- Read the bounded takeaway

Pattern: state-transformation. Native default duration: 8s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### before

- Target: .card:first-child
- Visible action: Establish the original state
- Authored start: 1.2s; action duration: 0.6s.
- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Establish the original state. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### after

- Target: .card.after

- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal the changed state. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

### takeaway

- Narration cue: When the corresponding narration clause begins: State the bounded difference. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.

- Visible action: Restore both comparable states
- Authored start: 6.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.
